reviews.body: love love love this dress, so much I ordered it in black and anothe black & white striped. I love that it has pockets and the fabric is fantastic. It packs& washes well.

I selected this ANRABESS square neck mini dress as a gift for my sister, and it has proven to be an absolute standout piece for her summer wardrobe. Finding a dress that manages to be both effortlessly casual and polished enough for a nice dinner can be difficult, but this design hits that balance perfectly.
The olive color is rich and saturated, offering a beautiful earthy tone that looks sophisticated in various lighting. The fabric quality is impressive, feeling lightweight and breathable for the high heat of summer while remaining opaque enough to provide full coverage. One of the highlights is the smocked bodice combined with the puff sleeves, which creates a very flattering silhouette that accommodates different body types comfortably without feeling restrictive.
Functionality is clearly a priority with this design, as the inclusion of pockets is a game-changer. They are sewn into the seams discreetly so they do not add unnecessary bulk to the hips, yet they are deep enough to be actually useful. The length of the dress strikes a great chord as well, offering a flowy, feminine aesthetic that works well for beach vacations or simple daily errands.
The construction is solid with clean stitching throughout, and it has held up beautifully after the initial wash without any shrinking or loss of color vibrancy. My sister has mentioned several times how comfortable the square neckline is, as it stays in place without shifting. This is a high-quality, thoughtful gift that looks far more expensive than its price tag suggests.

I think that this dress is good for the price. It makes a great airy summer dress. The material is thin, which is perfect for the hot weather. It also is quite plain making it a nice staple to have in your closet. You can very easily dress it up as well as dress it down if you want depending on how you accessorize. As far as the fit goes, I think that if it’s comfortable and again is quite plain, but in a good way, as you can accessorize really well. It’s very easy to wash/dry, I just tossed it in with my other clothes, no problem whatsoever. It comes a little below the thighs, making it very modest in my opinion, which I actually like a lot. And it’s very wrinkle resistant, which is great. Overall, I think that this dress is great.

products.search_term: Target Women's Short Sleeve Backless Knit Maxi Dress - A New Day™

reviews.body: I love this cute dress. Wash it in cold. Tumble 5 to ten minutes hang it up and it will last longer. You can pair it with practically anything except shorts. lol.

I own several dresses from Daily Ritual that are made in this same Jersey material. I consider it to actually be more of a stretchy t-shirt type material that what I think of as jersey.

I now generally wear a size large but I bought this in an XL to accommodate an undershirt that I am wearing that keeps seems away from my skin while I recover from a health issue. If I were not wearing this undershirt, I would definitely buy a large.

The dress is extremely comfortable and doesn't bind anywhere. The neck is crew and the sleeves are short. I am 5'6” and the dress hits me right at the ankle. The slit is on the left side and stops just below my knee (though, I do have longer legs than normal for my height, so on others it may hit right at the knee.)

There is no seam in the back (which is very important to me right now.) The seams are on the two sides.

The only thing I would change about this dress is that there is a tag at the neck. I wish they had printed the info on the inside of the dress or included the tag low somewhere on the side seam below the hip.

In the photos that I hope to include, it shows the dress as it fits me with the t-shirt underneath. I have washed it and it didn't shrink appreciably. I have worn and washed my other dresses in this line everyday for five months and they are still in good shape.

The dress I purchased first is in a dark heather gray. I was happy to see this color and wish that Daily Ritual would expand the line to carry other colors than simply neutral ones.

I will be buying more of these dresses, starting with the basic black. It's a great dress for those of us who prefer not to wear shorter dresses. The slit will keep it cooler in warm weather and the longer length will keep the legs warm when it is cool outside.

I bought this for the summer as a comfortable low key dress for errands. It is soft, fits as expected, and is decent quality. It faded a little on first wash so I don't expect it to last more than a season which is so wasteful.

products.search_term: Target Women's Corset Sundress - A New Day™

reviews.body: Very happy with the quality and fit of this dress. It is true to size, the fabric flows beautifully and is very silky. I would definitely buy it in other colors. It has a stretchy back panel and the straps are also adjustable for a good fit. The zipper is small and delicate but fits with the overall aesthetic of the dress. It's incredibly flattering and perfect for summer. The fabric is very light and flowy. I steamed the garment upon arrival before wearing and it looks wonderful.

Loved the dress. It has a faux corset look, but you’ll need structured foundation garments to get that corset shape. The fabric is light and airy—perfect for a hot summer day. It’s comfortable and flattering. We hiked all over the park in this dress and it was not restrictive or scratchy.

Only wore it once, so I can’t comment on the longevity.

Let me start by saying, it's a beautiful dress. The feel and quality are great! It's silky, soft, yet light. I don't think I'd be sweating in this dress, it feels great for a summer day. The straps are quite adjustable, there's a hidden zipper along the side to help you into it, a liner to keep it from being see through, and there's even some well hidden and functional pockets!
BUT.
This dress is not for A cups. The shells/bust shape is too large, and leaves the dress on someone more petite like me looking baggy. I'm not even sure if it would be good for a B cup, because they're so large. So just a warning to those of us that are on the smaller side. It probably won't look right or fit your body the way it should.
